There are 60 minutes in an hour.

Regarding the competitor analysis: Streamline Autos' direct-to-consumer (DTC) model poses a significant strategic threat to traditional automotive businesses. By eliminating dealership markups, they can offer lower prices, which may pressure our margins or force us to reconsider our pricing structures. Furthermore, their direct engagement allows for real-time data collection on consumer preferences, enabling faster product iterations and more targeted marketing. To counter this, we should consider enhancing our own digital sales channels, improving transparency in pricing, and leveraging our existing dealership network for superior after-sales service and customer experience, which remains a key differentiator for many buyers.
